entries.name: Graduate Development Programme
entries.notes: 2027 cohort opens 17 Sept 2026. Includes a building surveying pathway. Confirmed 2026-08-07: applications open 17 Sept, close 13 Nov 2026; online assessments Sept-Nov; assessment centres Nov 2026-Mar 2027.

entries.name: Building Surveying Graduate Scheme
entries.notes: Rolling recruitment on their Early Careers site, worth checking live status directly. Confirmed 2026-08-07: graduate schemes/placements/apprenticeships currently closed, reopening Autumn 2026.

entries.name: UK Graduate Programme
entries.notes: Advisory/workplace solutions route, crossover with real estate and heritage assets. Confirmed 2026-08-07: 2-year Building Surveying pathway within Project Management & Building Consultancy dept, supports RICS APC; requires RICS-accredited degree/masters, 2:1 min. No 2027 deadline published yet, page returned 403 on direct fetch this run - check manually.

entries.name: Fast Stream 2027 Intake
entries.notes: Reopens Oct 2026. Heritage-adjacent policy route, e.g. DCMS. Confirmed 2026-08-07: pattern still applications open ~Oct, close ~early Nov, consistent with tracked deadline; official 2027 dates not yet formally published.

entries.name: Assistant Building Surveyor
entries.notes: Condition surveys, measured surveys, party wall and dilapidations. APC support in benefits. Tailored CV and cover letter sent. Role still listed live as of 2026-08-07.

entries.name: Assistant Surveyor (QS)
entries.notes: Quantity surveying focus, off the heritage building surveying trajectory. Hard-excluded: QS-only, no building surveying pathway.

entries.name: Graduate Programme (Investment/Development)
entries.notes: New-build residential investment and development. No heritage angle. Hard-excluded: new-build/investment-only, no heritage or surveying-practice angle.

entries.name: Assistant Surveyor (QS)
entries.notes: Commercial QS role on public-sector projects. Different RICS pathway to building surveying, no heritage overlap. Hard-excluded: QS-only, no building surveying pathway.

entries.name: Graduate Building Surveyor
entries.notes: Found via RICS Recruit. Hybrid London/South. Requires RICS-accredited building surveying degree already completed, APC pathway support, chartership targeted in 12-24 months. Deprioritised 2026-08-07: assumes completed degree, incompatible with ongoing part-time MSc (to Aug 2027). Deadline was 2026-08-10 anyway.

entries.name: Graduate Building Surveyor - Birmingham
entries.notes: Found via RICS Recruit. Birmingham, £34,000. Deprioritised 2026-08-07: not commutable to Kingston University for ongoing part-time MSc; hard-excluded going forward.

entries.name: Graduate Building Surveyor - London
entries.notes: Found via RICS Recruit. London, competitive salary. Location fits, but likely assumes a completed degree (standard 'graduate' agency listing) - worth a direct enquiry about part-qualified/currently-studying candidates before ruling out.

entries.name: Graduate Building Surveyor
entries.notes: Found via RICS Recruit. Glasgow, circa £27,000 + bonus + benefits. Deprioritised 2026-08-07: not commutable to Kingston University for ongoing part-time MSc; hard-excluded going forward.

entries.name: Graduate Building Surveyor - APC Support (Warwickshire)
entries.notes: Found via RICS Recruit. Warwickshire, £25,000-£30,000, immediate summer start, APC support explicit. Deprioritised 2026-08-07: immediate full-time start + non-commutable location incompatible with ongoing part-time MSc; hard-excluded going forward.

entries.name: Graduate Building Surveyor - APC Support (Dartford)
entries.notes: Found via RICS Recruit. Dartford, Kent, £25,000-£30,000, APC support explicit. Deprioritised 2026-08-07: immediate-start framing likely assumes a completed degree; hard-excluded going forward pending direct enquiry.

entries.name: Engagement Officer - Roding Rises
entries.notes: FLAGGED - UNCERTAIN FIT: community river-engagement role (River Roding restoration), funded by the National Lottery Heritage Fund, but this is environmental/river heritage rather than built-heritage or building surveying. Part-time 0.3 FTE (1.5 days/week), 2.5-year contract to Mar 2029, London (Guildhall-adjacent), £36,353-£38,536 pro rata. Deadline is today (2026-08-07) so likely not actionable this cycle - included per instructions to flag rather than drop, but low priority given timing.
